records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Revenue increased 23% in the third quarter and 18% in the nine months of 2021 primarily due to volume growth in residential delivery services at FedEx Ground and U.S. domestic package volume growth at FedEx Express, both reflecting increased e-commerce demand accelerated by the COVID-19 pandemic.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Residential delivery volume growth, reflecting increased e-commerce demand accelerated by the coronavirus (“COVID-19”) pandemic, as well as yield improvement related to pricing initiatives, continued in the third quarter, driving strong growth in our revenue and operating income during the third quarter and nine months of 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Higher costs associated with operating our seven-day network at FedEx Ground and operating our air network to support higher demand in key international supply chains impacted by constrained commercial air capacity were also incurred in the third quarter and nine months of 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We continued to incur increased operating expenses to support unprecedented levels of demand for our services in the COVID-19 pandemic environment.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our consolidated operating income improved during both the third quarter and nine months of 2021 due to residential volume growth at FedEx Ground, international export and U.S. domestic package volume growth at FedEx Express and pricing initiatives across all of our transportation segments.
